name: central_room_pull
description: Walk from Corridor A (its levy already dealt with, as after levy_1v1_sensible) into Level 1's central room and bear right toward the Corridor B mouth, then stand, recording who engages. It checks that detection needs line of sight (design bible §3) and that an encounter never pulls enemies from another room (§4): before sight rays, the Corridor B archer detected the player through the room's south wall.
